subject: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Wong <chris.wong@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned on economics and approvals:

Summary of your workload (as discussed):
- Estimated token volume: ~3.5B tokens/month (prompt ~25% / completion ~75%).
- Peak concurrency target: moderate; latency SLOs: 200–400ms 95th for user-facing flows.

Economic targets you mentioned on the call:
- Target price: around $1,000 per 1M tokens (ballpark).
- Procurement: expect finance + legal review, ~4–6 week timeline once we engage procurement.

To move forward we need 3 quick confirmations from your side:
1) Economic buyer (who signs/owns the budget?)
2) Budget owner/approver (finance person who will sign off)
3) Any procurement constraints (PO terms, required SLA/credits, or compliance docs)

Attached: high-level pricing tiers and a short MOPP (minimal operational purchase pack) we can share with finance.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can confirm the three items above, I’ll schedule a 30-minute pricing + procurement alignment with our contracts and finance folks.
- If helpful, we can draft a 3-month pilot commitment with a defined consumption band to speed procurement.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with Dana/finance once you loop them in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers.pdf, Redwood_MOPP.xlsx

From: Chris Wong <chris.wong@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Schultz <dana.schultz@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

1) Economic buyer: CFO Sonya Patel (sonya.patel@fintechco.com) — she owns the budget for platform spending.
2) Finance approver / day-to-day contact: Dana Schultz (cc'd). Dana handles the procurement checklist and vendor onboarding.
3) Budget owner for this initiative: VP Product, Michael Reyes (michael.reyes@fintechco.com) — he will own the budget line but Sonya signs.

On volumes: the 3.5B/month is our conservative estimate; if we roll out to more customers it could grow to ~8–10B/mo in 6–9 months.

On price: Sonya's team is targeting a unit cost in the neighborhood of $800–1,000 per 1M tokens for a committed/volume-discounted tier.

Procurement notes:
- Standard vendor onboarding and SOC2 evidence required.
- We typically aim for a 30–45 day procurement window once SOW/PO is ready.

Happy to schedule Dana + Sonya for a short alignment next week. Can you include your contracts and finance leads?

Thanks,
Chris
Head of Product Integrations, FinTechCo
chris.wong@fintechco.com
+1 (650) 555-9876

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Wong <chris.wong@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dana Schultz <dana.schultz@fintechco.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment

Thanks Chris — that is super helpful. Looping in next: Sean (contracts lead) and Laura (solutions/technical lead) so we can assemble a short packet for Sonya and Dana.

Pricing + unit economics (high level):
- Hosted API (no commitment): $1,400 / 1M tokens (list).
- Committed monthly (3–12 month reserves) for 1–5B tokens: $1,050 / 1M tokens.
- Committed monthly for 5–10B tokens: $900 / 1M tokens.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) options: custom pricing — typically $600–850 / 1M tokens depending on model and latency SLAs.

Estimated unit economics (how we price this to hit those rates):
- Infra & GPU cost (approx): $300 / 1M tokens (depends on model, quantization).
- Platform & support allocation: $100 / 1M tokens.
- Margin / commercial buffer: remainder (negotiable on committed volumes + term).

Given your 3.5B baseline and growth path, a committed 6-month band at ~$900–1,050 / 1M tokens is where we can move quickly.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share the short MOPP + pricing tiers (attached) for Sonya/Dana to review.
2) Schedule a 30-min alignment call (Marissa/Sean/Laura + Dana + Sonya if available + Michael).
3) If they prefer, we can put together a draft SOW and a 3-month pilot commitment (consumption band + early termination terms) to accelerate procurement.

Sean & Laura — any redlines or must-have items you want me to include in the SOW (trial metrics, support SLAs, credits)?

Best,
Marissa
--

Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment

Quick note from contracts:

- For a committed 3–6 month pilot at your volumes, we can offer an initial pilot price of $1,100 / 1M tokens with a consumption band (e.g., 2.5–4.5B). If volume exceeds the upper band, we apply the next tier pricing retroactively for that month.
- If Sonya requires enterprise terms (SLA credits, specific indemnities), that will push to a separate enterprise SOW (longer timeline).
- We should include a 60-day review clause in the pilot so finance can validate actual spend vs. forecast.

Marissa — I’ll prep a one-page SOW (pilot + acceptance metrics) and drop it in the Drive folder. Chris/Dana — do you prefer a Tue or Wed slot next week for the alignment call?

—Sean
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
